confirmedFindings.title: CoW ready markers do not attest declared and locked installed dependencies
confirmedFindings.impact: Current configured bases omit declared locked Angular localize and ESLint plugins, and ETC has Playwright1.63.0 against lock1.59.1. Empty setup returns success; marker hashes lock bytes/workspace names/ABI; root readiness enumerates existing installed packages, hiding omitted declarations. New tasks inherit the broken install.
confirmedFindings.scopedFix: Persist locked Node setup commands. Before publishing/reusing a generation, validate required declared/locked packages and versions, refreshing future generations on mismatch. Keep intentional dangling file/link dependency exceptions and preserve busy/parked clones.
acceptance: Populated node_modules missing a required locked package or containing a wrong locked Playwright version is not publishable/reusable as ready.
A fresh repaired generation completes maintained lint/build and a matching-browser smoke without task-specific package repairs or lockfile changes.
Warm reuse remains cached, parked work survives generation replacement, and Maven non-Node roots plus intentional dangling local links remain supported.

confirmedFindings.title: Browser readiness accepts a cache for a different Playwright revision
confirmedFindings.impact: ETC installed Playwright expects Chromium1243, cache has1217/1234, but maintained host probe returns installed/usable true with no missing reasons.
confirmedFindings.scopedFix: Retain filesystem-first probing, TTL and singleflight. Resolve the installed package browsers.json and platform executable; require the exact revision. Distinguish installed from usable and cache one bounded proof for the selected worker runtime rather than spawning per heartbeat.
acceptance: Local Playwright requiring1243 with only1234 cache returns not-installed/not-usable without CLI spawn.

Concurrent polls preserve singleflight and do not recreate the prior Playwright --version process storm.
